home.title: Qaemati demo restaurants
home.subtitle: Two sample menus, built to show what a restaurant’s own Qaemati menu looks like.
home.description: Pick a restaurant to open its live menu:

demo.panelDescription: This is a demo environment. Sign in to either restaurant's admin panel with the credentials below -- no account needed.
demo.resetConfirm: This restores both demo restaurants to their original sample menus and undoes any changes made in the admin panel. Continue?

errors.notFoundBody: Sorry, the page you are looking for does not exist.
errors.serverErrorBody: Sorry for the inconvenience, we are working on fixing it.

selection.title: My selection
selection.emptyDescription: Tap "+" on a menu item to add it here.
selection.disclaimer: This sends a WhatsApp message to the restaurant to ask about your order. It is not an online order and no payment is made here.
selection.noWhatsappNotice: This restaurant has not added a WhatsApp number yet, so selections can’t be sent here.

menu.selectVariantPrompt: Choose a size to add this to your selection

pwa.offlineDescription: This menu isn't available right now. Reconnect and try again.

auth.title: Admin Login
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.

form.allergenNoteHint: Optional -- for anything the tags above don't cover, e.g. "fried in the same oil as shellfish."

categories.title: Categories
categories.emptyDescription: Add your first category to start building the menu.
categories.deleteConfirmBody: This will also delete every item in it. This cannot be undone.
categories.availabilityHint: Leave both empty to show this category all day, e.g. for a Breakfast category available 07:00-11:00.

items.emptyTitle: No items in this category yet
items.emptyDescription: Add your first item to this category.
items.imageTooLarge: Image must be smaller than 5 MB.
items.invalidImageType: Please upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
items.variantsHint: Each size has its own full price. Leave empty if this item has no sizes.
items.addonsHint: Optional extras added on top of the price, e.g. "Extra cheese".

bulk.title: Bulk tools
bulk.changePricesHint: Select items below, then enter a percentage (e.g. 10 for +10%, -10 for -10%).
bulk.priceChangeInvalid: Select at least one item and enter a non-zero percent.
bulk.importHint: Columns: id, category, nameAr, nameEn, price, currency, available. Leave id blank to create a new item; category must match an existing category's English name exactly.
bulk.undoAvailableLabel: You can undo your last bulk action
bulk.emptyDescription: Add items from the Categories page first.

qr.title: QR codes & printing
qr.generalCaption: Scanning this opens your full public menu.
qr.emptyDescription: Add a table to generate a QR code for it.
qr.deleteConfirmBody: Its QR code will stop working. This cannot be undone.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.emptyDescription: Once people start opening your menu, you'll see your numbers here.

branding.title: Branding
branding.hoursHint: Leave both empty to hide the live open/closed badge on the public menu. Set both to show it.
branding.currencyHint: Used as the default for new items, e.g. ILS, JOD, USD.
branding.primaryColorHint: Used for buttons and highlights on your public menu. Must stay readable with white text.
branding.contrastPassLabel: {ratio}:1 contrast with white text -- passes AA
branding.contrastFailLabel: {ratio}:1 contrast with white text -- too light, pick a darker color
branding.colorContrastToast: That color is too light to stay readable with white text. Pick a darker shade.
branding.bothHoursRequiredToast: Set both an opening and a closing time, or leave both empty.
branding.secondaryColorHint: A second color for smaller highlights, like the Instagram link button. Must stay readable as dark text on its own light tint.
branding.backgroundColorHint: The page background behind everything else. Must stay readable with the menu's text.
branding.backgroundColorContrastToast: That background is too dark for the menu's text to stay readable. Pick a lighter shade.
branding.backgroundImageHint: Upload a photo below to use as the page background.
branding.facebookHint: A page name or the full page link.
branding.mapUrlHint: An https link from Google Maps or any map service.
branding.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number, for example 02 222 0111.
branding.invalidFacebook: Enter a Facebook page name or its full link.
branding.invalidMapUrl: Enter a link that starts with https.

tour.step1Body: This dashboard is where you manage your categories and items. Add a category, then add items to it -- every change appears on your public menu immediately.
tour.step2Body: Open any item to set sizes (variants), extras (add-ons), or mark it as today's special. Categories can also have their own time window, e.g. a Breakfast category shown only in the morning.
tour.step3Body: The QR codes page generates a printable code for your tables and a general one for your door or receipts -- each one opens your public menu directly.
tour.step4Body: The Branding page is where you set your logo, cover image, primary color, and currency -- your public menu picks these up automatically.

validation.invalidOption: Pick one of the available options.
